title: alisma graminifolium
intro: Alisma graminifolium, commonly known as Zhe be mu, is a type of aquatic plant that belongs to the Alismataceae family. It is traditionally used in Asian medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and lowering blood sugar levels. The therapeutic actions of Alisma graminifolium are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and diuretic properties, which help to relieve edema, urinary disorders, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
